en_how: Black bars hold a roughly 2.6:1 frame throughout (taller in portrait, bars kept); the ground is a warm brown-black radial gradient with three speeds of drifting dust; each centred card follows a black–bright–black breathing curve in t, the amber eyebrow widens its letter spacing, large serif numerals glow through stacked shadowBlur passes, a bronze hairline opens from the centre, and at the title a horizontal lens flare sweeps across with a small shake.
